system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}
user:
CONCEPT: Normal dendroidal set

ATOM HMDEND-C01-S2-02 (S2): The class of normal monomorphisms of dendroidal sets is the smallest weakly saturated class containing the boundary inclusions $\partial\Omega[T]\to\Omega[T]$ for every tree $T$ in $\Omega$, because every normal monomorphism is a transfinite composition of pushouts of such boundary inclusions.

EVIDENCE:
[HMDEND-p0145-s12] Theorem 3.31 The class of normal monomorphisms is the smallest weakly saturated class containing the boundary inclusion ∂Ω[T] →Ω[T] for every tree T in Ω.
[HMDEND-p0145-s16] To see that these classes are equal one applies Proposition 3.26, which shows that any normal monomorphism can be written as a transfinite composition of pushouts of boundary inclusions of trees. □

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — Separately asserts the smallest weakly saturated class characterization and a transfinite pushout decomposition of every normal monomorphism. / Combines two distinct claims: the weakly saturated class characterization (Theorem 3.31) and the transfinite composition of pushouts characterization (Proposition 3.26).
- L1_ONLY: revise — Remove the explanatory 'because' clause; it adds a separately assessable decomposition theorem to the recall-level characterization. / Remove the 'because...' clause, which stacks a second major characterization as a proof justification.
raw: {"atoms": [{"statement": "The class of normal monomorphisms of dendroidal sets is the smallest weakly saturated class containing the boundary inclusions $\\partial\\Omega[T]\\to\\Omega[T]$ for every tree $T$ in $\\Omega$.", "scope": "S1", "evidence_ids": ["HMDEND-p0145-s12"]}, {"statement": "Any normal monomorphism of dendroidal sets can be written as a transfinite composition of pushouts of boundary inclusions of trees.", "scope": "S2", "evidence_ids": ["HMDEND-p0145-s16"]}], "note": "Split the atom into two claims and dropped the 'because' clause that linked them."}
